attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012179461 (CC0): the corbelled corner turret with its slate spire, the scrolled stone dormer gables, the rusticated ground storey with round-arched shop windows and the lettered Amstel 2 doorcase, the block-surround windows, the patterned brick friezes and yellow brick bands, the cornice, the mansard and its flat dormer, the paired windows and the DIAMOND FACTORY fascia of the Muntplein front, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
